evidence: Matches the 'Utils/log/libs' label and edits 'src/util/fs_helpers.cpp', modifying the shared file allocation utility.
rationale: Fixes a data corruption bug where the fallback AllocateFileRange zero-fills existing block data during -reindex. According to commit 65b44fcf0b, on platforms without posix_fallocate (*BSDs, OmniOS, OpenIndiana), 'this could overwrite existing block data in blk*.dat files before the reindex scan ran', corrupting chain data and breaking -reindex entirely.
